text.en:
Recognition of the name Lapulapu. The name Lapulapu is
understood to refer to the Filipino hero who bravely and victoriously fought in the Battle
THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES

of Mactan in the 16th century. Thus, all references to the name "Lapu-Lapu" in EO No.
17, as amended, and EO No. 55, as amended, are hereby amended to read as
All government agencies and instrumentalities, including government-owned
or -controlled corporations, and state universities and colleges, are hereby directed,
and local government units, non-government organizations, civil society groups, and
the private sector, are hereby enjoined to adopt "Lapulapu when referring to the name
of the first Filipino hero.
The foregoing notwithstanding, the official names of places such as Lapu-Lapu
City, having been established by statute, shall continue to be respected.

Repeal. Except for the foregoing amendments, all other provisions
of EO Nos. 17 and 55, and their amendatory EOs shall remain unchanged. All other
orders, rules and regulations or parts thereof which are contrary or inconsistent with
this Order are hereby modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect upon its publication in the
Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 6th day of December
of our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-One.
By the President:
SALVADOR C. MEDIALDEA
Executive Secretary &
Office of the President
MALACAMANS RECORDS OFFICE
ATTY. CONCEPCION 20
REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES
